The '''1972–73 Cypriot First Division''' was the 34th season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league.

==Overview==
It was contested by 14 teams, and [[APOEL F.C.]] won the championship.  [[AC Omonia]] participated in the [[1972–73 Alpha Ethniki|Greek championship]] as the previous year's champions. They finished in 18th position.
